A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Point2RBox-v3 research. Their complete main texts and appendices, including equations, tables and figures, are readable and support reliable matching across the revision.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection results, module and parameter ablations, and partially weakly supervised experiments on DOTA, DIOR, STAR and RSAR (Tables 1–6).

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds prior-selection and threshold ablations, failure examples, and original OCDPCB and DIATOM evaluations.

M1.justification: The PLA procedure, SAM/watershed routing, prior-guided mask selection, architecture and losses remain substantively unchanged. The classification-score explanation and loss-configuration table disclose details rather than establish a new method.

E1.justification: v3 adds actual evaluations on printed-circuit-board components (OCDPCB) and diatoms (DIATOM), extending demonstrated coverage beyond remote sensing into industrial inspection and biological imagery (Appendix A.9, Table 10). The original datasets and partially weakly supervised tasks remain.

E2.justification: New Table 6 evaluates NoPrior-Loss, which selects masks using SAM's native confidence instead of the proposed prior-guided scoring. The original benchmark comparator lists are unchanged; using Point2RBox-v2 on the two new datasets extends coverage rather than introduces another baseline.

E3.justification: v3 adds the native-confidence control, finer threshold settings, and new dataset protocols with 445/191 OCDPCB and 1758/439 DIATOM training/test splits. Appendix A.8 reports an RSAR-specific threshold of 6, qualifying v1's common-hyperparameter description; this does not establish that existing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v3 adds a focused test of whether prior-guided scoring improves upon SAM confidence (Table 6), extends the existing threshold sensitivity analysis (Table 9), and provides segmentation and detector failure cases (Figures 6–7). The earlier module, switch-epoch and class-specific watershed analyses remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or result error bars. References to confidence scores and pixel standard deviations concern the algorithm, not experimental uncertainty.

E6.justification: Original Tables 1–5 and the PWOOD results are unchanged. New results include NoPrior-Loss at 57.86/63.59 versus PGDM-Loss at 59.61/66.09, OCDPCB/DIATOM scores of 40.9/77.6 versus Point2RBox-v2's 36.4/69.0, and additional threshold and failure findings. Table 9 reports 56.6/64.6 at an infinite threshold, conflicting with 57.2/66.1 retained in Table 5; this is not an established performance correction.

T1.justification: Equations 1–15 and their substantive mathematical content are retained. Added task notation, symbol explanations and pseudocode notation edits clarify existing material; no new theorem, proof, assumption or derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central claims about PLA, complementary SAM/watershed supervision, partially weakly supervised applicability and the six headline benchmark scores. Additional appendix evidence does not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: v3 explains why SAM confidence can misrank remote-sensing masks and expands limitations to joint segmentation failures involving texture and geometry, plus detector angle and scale errors. It also recommends a threshold range of 4–6 and interprets the new domain results as evidence of broader applicability.

D1.justification: v3 supplies exact loss weights and implementation types (Table 8), defines the PLA classification score, and adds dataset splits, resolutions, access links and a project-page link. Existing training details largely move from Appendix A.5 to Section 4.1. The code link remains, but the explicit configuration/script/checkpoint release promise is removed.

R1.justification: Section 3.1 and new Appendix A.1 expand the comparison with earlier Point2RBox models, distinguishing synthetic-pattern/symmetry supervision from spatial-layout learning and v3's additions. The scholarly reference set is retained; the Point2RBox-v2 publication update does not introduce a different work.

P1.justification: v3 expands the task overview, moves experimental details into the main text, adds appendix subsections and switches citation style. It removes the separate PWOOD subsection heading and ethics, reproducibility and LLM-use statements. Most existing prose and the overall argument remain intact.

P2.justification: The document receives a substantial visual redesign, including institutional branding, a boxed abstract, blue headings, changed typography and wider, reflowed displays. Four tables and two failure figures are added. Existing Figures 1–5 are retained, and the original PWOOD table becomes Table 7.

improvement.justification: v3 improves support for prior-guided selection, demonstrates applicability in two additional domains, documents loss settings and makes failure conditions more concrete. These are useful gains without changing the method or original benchmark results. However, conflicting infinite-threshold scores in Tables 5 and 9 and the unreconciled RSAR exception to the common-settings statement limit reporting reliability, making the overall improvement modest.
